snippet.title: 007 First Light – Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
#007FirstLight #EarnTheNumber

IO Interactive presents the world-first gameplay reveal for 007 First Light, an exciting new chapter in James Bond’s legacy in video games.

In this 30-minute premiere, you will get:

🕵️ 20 minutes of gameplay walkthrough: experience Bond’s first mission in the field, where Bond and his teammates are tasked with catching the rogue agent 009. 

🎮 10 minutes of developer commentary: a deep dive into the game’s mechanics, gadgets, stealth systems and combats.

007 First Light comes to PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC on March 27th, 2026.

Pre-order now and get a free Deluxe Edition Upgrade.

https://bit.ly/3HTtrCY

Our channels
Visit the website: https://www.007FirstLightGame.com
Discord: https://www.discord.gg/007FirstLight 
Twitter: https://x.com/007Gameioi 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@007gameioi
 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/007GameIOI/ 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/007Gameioi 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/007game.ioi.dk 
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/007Gameioi 
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/007FirstLight/

Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

ABOUT IO INTERACTIVE IO 
Interactive is an independent videogame developer and publisher with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Istanbul, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last two decades, IOI is dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences using their award-winning proprietary Glacier technology. IO Interactive will develop and publish a reimagined James Bond origin story with 007 First Light and is currently developing a new IP under the codename Project Fantasy. For more information, visit: https://ioi.dk.
